task: per-user leave-five-out slate continuation (OGR arXiv:2608.17613 / HiGR arXiv:2512.24787 alignment)
source_events_note: Reuses the verified deduplicated big_matrix events of kuairec_listwise_v1 (same cleaning, duplicate and ambiguity rules). Invalid and ambiguous (same user, same timestamp) events are dropped from sequences.
split: per user: last 5 records = test, previous 5 = validation, earlier non-overlapping blocks = train (history >= 5)
slate_rule: consecutive records, stride 5 anchored at sequence end; retain repeated items in every split
short_user_note: 15..19 records permit held-out slates and a training prefix, but no supervised train block; report explicitly
zero_play_events: kept as impressions (in history and targets)
